intro: Donmac Specialized Sourcing connects Zambian clients to reputable global manufacturers and suppliers. We source customer-specific products, equipment and services, and manage the supply chain end to end: specification, supplier vetting, quality verification, freight and customs clearance, so the right equipment arrives on time and fully compliant.
introPoints: Heavy and industrial equipment, including tipper trucks and prime movers
